title: Client Mods
wikitext: Client mods (which come in the form of ".mpq" files) represent packed data for your client to load which can be used to enhance your gaming experience - primarily focusing on visuals. These '''mods are not officialy supported by the Turtle WoW team!''' You must remember how to uninstall and reinstall these mods if they cause any problems you experience! Messing with your Data/ folder can interfere with gameplay and cripple your client if you are careless about the potential risks. == '''WARNING: Use at your own risk''' == All these mods may break the game in one way or another. In case things are not working properly disable or remove those custom mods via the official launcher. ==Installation== To install a client mod, download the .mpq file, and drag it into TurtleWoW/Data/. To uninstall a mod, just delete the corresponding .mpq file from the Data folder. When using the '''Turtle WoW''' Launcher, you should enable the mods in the launcher's "Mods" tab (refer to picture). [[File:Turtle_Launcher_Mod_Configuration.png|thumb|206x206px]] '''Sometimes two mods share the same name and conflict.''' That is okay since you can easily rename these mods to different patch letters and numbers. Turtle WoW uses the early numbers for its own client mods that allow the client to function, so avoid using numbers and early letters, and keep to using later letters first. The client loads the mods in order, '''starting''' with patch-1.mpq, '''ending''' in patch-Z.mpq. {| class="fandom-table" !Filename (*.mpq) !Information !Remark |- |patch-9.mpq |Pretty Night Sky | |- |patch-B.mpq |Bikini Mod | |- |patch-C.mpq |Old Vanilla Ogres | |- |patch-E.mpq |Alt HD |Enhanced environment |- |patch-F.mpq |WotLK Feral Forms | |- |patch-I.mpq |Incubus | |- |patch-W.mpq |CLASSIIC HD |Enhances buildings and items, requiring Turtle/Alt HD for character and creature updates. |- |patch-X.mpq |high elf modification |Depends on TurtleHD, Alt-mod , high elf eyes glow |- |patch-Z.mpq |Darker Night |Note: if you already have an MPQ named "patch-Z" in your data folder, rename this one to a different name. The original patch-Z is used for localization. |} ==Available Mods== Community member '''RetroCro''' has salvaged links from archived and cached pages to provide a one-stop collection of links for all mods [https://github.com/RetroCro/TurtleWoW-Mods listed here on their Github]. ===Turtle HD: Reforged=== [[File:Turtle HD.jpg|thumb|Turtle HD mod]]This mod backports many character models and textures, as well as environment textures, from Legion and later WoW versions, to Turtle's vanilla client. As with many, this is quite a hefty mod that changes quite a lot of assets, so be sure to check the forums post and consider contacting the author with any issues/concerns. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=21355 forum post here]. === '''Alt HD''' (discontinued) === [[File:Image 2023-10-11 093417481.png|thumb|Alt HD mod]]This mod, similar to Turtle HD, backports some assets from retail but with a bigger emphasis on overhauling ground clutter and tilesets. Alt HD has been discontinued in 2024. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=10741 forum post here]. ===Darker Nights=== [[File:Dhs1.png|thumb|180x180px|Demon Hunter skin]]While the brightness of night time in 2006 wow is rather dark compared to modern wow, this mod aims to darken things down significantly for a much more immersive feel. Duskwood is even darker than the rest, making Darkshire actually true to its name! '''IMPORTANT''': This mod used to be called Patch-Z but TWoW is using that internally for language localization. Renamed to Patch-Y. for the time being. This version of Dark Nights has been modified to work better under Turtle WoW, * [https://github.com/RetroCro/TurtleWoW-Mods/raw/refs/heads/main/Archive/Darker%20Nights.zip download it here] (Patch-Z). * [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=22135 UPDATE: version compatible with 1.8][[File:Pretty Night Sky.png|thumb|Pretty Night Sky mod]] === Deamon Hunter Skin === This simple mod change in HD mod Demon Hunter Skin for females Night elf's to more demonic one. * '''[https://github.com/Ragatho/TWoW-HD-Mod-NE-DH-Skin-female-only/tree/main Download]''' === Pretty Night Sky === Port over from one of Legion's Sky box to create a beautiful night sky. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=70273 forum post here].[[File:Cat druid compairson light.png|thumb|WotLK Feral Forms]] === WotLK Feral Forms === This backports the WotLK model for both Night Elf and Tauren Druids' bear and cat forms. * [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seacrabsam/patch-druid/main/patch-F.mpq Direct Download Link] (Patch-F). === Incubus === [[File:Incubus mod.png|thumb|Incubus mod]] This replaces the Warlock Succubus pet with an Incubus. * [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seacrabsam/patch-incubus/main/patch-I.mpq Direct Download Link] (Patch-I). === High Elf Modifications === [[File:Void Elf skin.png|thumb|High Elf mod]] A few small mods aiming to modify the High Elf race, requires '''Turtle HD.''' * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=8843 forum post here]. === Enhanced HD Water === This mod replaces Vanilla's water textures, softening them and making them generally less noisy to look at. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=8786 forum post here]. === Blood Enhanced === This mod downports the blood mod from the WoW WotLK v3.3.5 client to enhance blood visuals in combat. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=10934 forum post here]. [[File:Fog Pushback.png|thumb|Fog Pushback mod]] === Fog Pushback === Pushes back fog significantly to increase view distance. Recommended to use this with VanillaTweaks for FarClip distance enhancement, details on [[Client Fixes and Tweaks#Vanilla-Tweaks|the wiki page here]]. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=10982 forum post here]. === Warcraft 3 Cursors === [[File:WC3 Cursors.png|thumb|138x138px|WC3 Cursors mod]]This mod made a little Warcraft 3 Cursor Interface Addon, should go well with Fiur's Warcraft 3 UI. Please follow Readme.txt Instructions for proper Installation. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=66202 forum post here]. === '''Bikini Mod''' === Alters multiple female equipment and armor sets to be significantly more revealing/skimpy as well as fixing specific issues with chest pieces and bras. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84463 forum post here]. === A little extra for Female High Elves, Humans, Night Elves === [[File:LilExtra4Female.png|thumb|A Little Extra mod]] This mod introduces significant geometry, animation and texture changes to female high elves, night elves and humans to provide aesthetic body and character model changes. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=12120 forum post here]. === Druid beast warrior forms for NE and TA === This patch replaces your Bear/Dire Bear Forms to Furbolg Form; Cat Form is changed to Tigon form (boss in ZG). Both new forms have faction-specific coloring. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=12883 forum post here]. === Better underwear for High elves === The design will vary depending on the skin color you choose, so it will be a surprise every time you create a new character. * Downloads and more info on the [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=12709 forum post here].[[File:Enlarged 4X size cursor on a 4K display.jpg|thumb|Enlarged 4X size cursor on a 4K display]] === Bigger mouse cursor === Vanilla WoW client has a hard-coded 32x32 pixel sized mouse cursor. We can't adjust it by UI scale nor display resolution. When running the game on a modern high DPI display like 4K resolution, the cursor would be too small. Vanilla client don't have the in-game option to set cursor size like Retail client. So here is a modified DXVK which gives a 2X sized cursor (64x64 pixel) which should be enough for 4K display resolution. It could even enlarge cursor into 3X or 4X size for 8K if needed, by its option. It could also load user-provided images into cursor. Maximum size is 128x128 pixel. Note that editing .MPQ file can't surpass 32x32 pixel limitation. * Downloads the modified DXVK from [https://github.com/kvoqkki/dxvk-bigger-cursor/actions GitHub Actions] === Arachnophobia === Arachnophobia patches. Crab, Rock Flayer, and Ravager. Modifies certain spider enemies into other monsters for those who have arachnophobia. * Downloads and more info on [https://github.com/seacrabsam/patch-arachnophobia Github here]. === Old Vanilla Ogres === Old Vanilla Ogres Model of Twow. Adapted for Twow by '''Amberember'''. * Download on [https://www.mediafire.com/file/gbblmuz1jsieju9/patch-C.MPQ/file MediaFire here for Patch-C]. === Turtle WoW GBank fix for SuperWoW === A client fix for SuperWoW users. This mod fixes an error message that occurs when being near the guild bank NPC without the guild bank open, and the interaction of items with charges when trying to deposit. This mod goes in your Data folder. * Download at [https://github.com/MarcelineVQ/SuperWoWGBankFix GitHub].
